source: 29.09.2026 chemistry workstream: hidden lab-chemistry and glassware recipes made craftable
notes: Lab chemistry that was excluded wholesale: acids, bases, solvents, salts, metal powders, glassware, welding rods and the basic analysis kit. Every input was already in the game; the ketene lamp and the small vacuum oven gained power profiles (electricity.json) so their charge rows can be met.

Still hidden on purpose: explosives and incendiaries (APEX, HMTD, RDX, thermite, dynamite, napalm, gelled gasoline, flamethrower fuel, rocket fuel and candy, smoke and gas bombs, white phosphorus from red), chemical-weapon ammo (chloramine, fungicidal and insecticidal gas), drug synthesis (caffeine, adrenaline, oxycodone, diazepam, topical cocaine, poppy sleep, cannabis concentrates), mutagen, serum, sample and purifier chemistry, mutant-blood and venom variants, the triffid fungicide and acid-chitin armour.

Still hidden for want of machines: calcium carbide (arc furnace appliance), the acetylene and oxyacetylene gases and the oxygen refills (acetylene machine, oxygen concentrator and compressor appliances; the torch runs without gas here), cracked lamp oil (catalytic cracking reactor), liquid ammonia (the makeshift ammonia reactor needs a 300 kg industrial pressure vessel) and the large closed-loop extractor.

Nothing in CDDA consumes acrylamide, peptone broth, nickel powder (diazepam only), chromium oxide (thermite only), the acidic electrolyte paste, the burette, the microscope, the microcentrifuge or the rotary evaporator (CONCENTRATE is asked only by drug, venom and mutagen recipes) or the vacuum pump (cannabis extraction only); the spectrophotometer, pH meter, cuvettes, small scale and melting point apparatus now go into the basic analysis kit.
